top_signals.title: Why Iraq Just Fast-Tracked Chevron’s Takeover Of A 14-Billion-Barrel Supergiant
top_signals.summary: U.S. supermajor Chevron has moved from open-ended negotiations under its previous USD200 million exclusivity window to finalising commercial terms for Iraq’s supergiant West Qurna 2 oilfield. Whilst the American firm originally had until February 2027 to use its one-year exclusivity window, following a very recent meeting between Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair Al-Abadi and Chevron’s vice president of business development Joe Cook, the two sides confirmed that contract terms for West Qurna 2 have now been agreed.
